nativeTensorRequirements.data: Finite Float32Array, exact configured manifest.profile.latentShape and element count. No global RGB value-range constraint.
nativeTensorRequirements.shape: Exact manifest.profile.latentShape; no inferred numeric shape for missing actual sample.
nativeTensorRequirements.modelSha256: Optional native field. If supplied, retain actual generation provenance and require membership in producerModelSha256s. Do not inject or replace with decoder VAE hash.
nativeTensorRequirements.normalization: Top-level field must be absent. Do not set normalized, restored or notnormalized as a top-level marker.

latentContract.producerModelSha256s: Nonempty unique lowercase64-hex list of actual producer models, excluding decoder VAE.

nativeTensorRequirements.context: Optional native context. If supplied, preserve validated source identity, ordered sourceFrameIndices and optional matching finite nonnegative times; do not require count=latent T.

nativeProfileRequirements.definition: Current fixed raw NCTHW profile with posterior=mean/opset17; generated-sample decode uses its exact latent/video shapes without relabeling the input as posterior mean.
nativeProfileRequirements.assets: Configured manifest/graph/conv2 files with actual bytes/SHA256; unchanged validated single-thread ORT WASM contract.
nativeProfileRequirements.exporterShapeRule: N=1,F=4n+1,H/W>=16 and multiples16. Native manifest structural spatial alignment is8; neither rule accepts arbitrary exact shapes.

outerEvidenceRequirements: Actual P5 source/build/graph/precision, operation, all used producer hashes and HIGH/LOW/LoRA/scheduler/noise execution trace.
